What I do at Microsoft

I'm a Principal Product Manager on the CAT team, focused on Toolkits & Partners. My work splits into two big areas — supporting our partner community, and helping the Toolkit team build and grow the Copilot Agent Kit.

🤝 How I support partners

  • Designing and facilitating training camps
  • Hosting community calls on educational topics
  • Holding 1:1 calls and orchestrating technical support
  • Organising and managing the community Teams channel

🧰 How I support the Toolkit team

  • Evangelising and increasing adoption of the Copilot Agent Kit
  • Creating blog and video content
  • Educating internal and external customers on product features
  • Creating story narratives for kit functionality
  • Providing feedback to the development team
  • Co-designing new features for the kit
